items.claim: FC Koebenhavn football director Kristjaan Speakman said the club fell short in the transfer window: 'Jeg vil vaere helt aaben omkring, at vi i sidste ende missede en profil. Vi ville gerne have haft endnu en kantspiller.'
items.source: Kristjaan Speakman, fodbolddirektoer, FC Koebenhavn, quoted by Fodbold-Transfers

items.claim: FC Koebenhavn director Jacob Lauesen pushed back on supporter criticism of the club's transfer window, saying 'Det er ikke rigtigt, at der ikke er sket ting.'
items.source: Jacob Lauesen, direktoer, FC Koebenhavn, quoted by Tipsbladet
